## Problem

What problem does this feature solve, and for which workflow (office, home, multi-display setup)?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature and how it would behave.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is this one better?

## Safety impact

Display Steward must never disable the last active display and must keep recovery evidence for every app-initiated disable. How does this feature preserve that, or does it introduce a new display-action path?

## Additional context

Mockups, references to similar tools, or anything else useful.
